purpose: Level 1-10 camps near the Crossroads: eleven hand-placed (Twilight's Eve ticket #7) and the wild camps, landmarks and two rares that wild_camps.py places from the ADT survey. Not vanilla spawns.
ground_z: z_hint is the ADT terrain height; the host resolves ground Z at runtime
source: creature entries, names, levels, display IDs and factions from the vmangos world DB (see barrens_spawns.json source)

camps.note: Mulgore's level 1-2 plainstriders, south-west of town. Neutral: a level-1 player picks the fight.
Durotar's level 1-2 boars, south-east of town.
Durotar's level 3 scorpids, east of town toward Thorn Hill (keep Thorn Hill's Razormane, 10-13, further out).
Durotar's level 3-4 imps, south of the plainstriders. Hostile. Their faction template has no call-for-help flag, so only the camp rule pulls them together.
A Mulgore quilboar camp, north-west of town: quilboars, shamans and a battleboar (level 3-5). Hostile; faction 111 answers calls for help.
Mulgore's level 5-6 wolves, the furthest low camp (south-east). Hostile; faction 38 answers calls for help.
Durotar's Razormane (level 6-9), on the east road toward Thorn Hill. Hostile; quilboar answer calls for help.
Durotar's Dustwind harpies (level 7-10), on the rocks north of town.
Mulgore's Palemane gnolls (level 5-8), north-west of town past the Bristleback.
Mulgore's level 9-10 Prairie Wolf Alphas, south-west beyond the gnolls.
Durotar's Bloodtalon raptors (level 6-10), south of town.
The rare The Rake (level 10), alone 585 yd west of the Hub. It takes ten minutes to come back.
The rare Ghost Howl (level 12), alone 570 yd east of the Hub. It takes ten minutes to come back.
